name: run-background-work
job: Run cron, queues, or jobs as Platform Work that HTTP-wakes a web service.

inScope: Creating Schedule, BatchJob, or Functions invoke Resources
outOfScope: Always-on customer worker processes as the destination

inputs: Activation kind and schedule or queue identity
outputs: Platform Work Resource that wakes the web handler
failureSemantics: A running process is not proof; the Work Operation must reach a typed terminal.

outcome.observable: A Platform Work Resource activates the app's type=web handler and the Operation reaches a typed terminal.
